title: Full-Body Strength Focus with Upper and Lower Emphasis

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through each repetition, focusing on spinal articulation. Inhale as you extend, exhale as you flex. Warm up the entire spine and core.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Extend opposite arm and leg slowly with control. Hold each rep for 1 second. Keep your hips level and core engaged throughout.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Rotate hips smoothly between 90/90 positions. Keep chest upright. This mobilizes hips and prepares them for lower body work.

items.name: Band Pullaparts
items.cues: Use light resistance band. Pull the band apart to chest height with slight bend in elbows. Squeeze shoulder blades together at the peak.

items.name: Bench Press
items.cues: Control descent to chest over 2 seconds. Drive feet into floor. Explosively press back up. Maintain neutral wrist position throughout.

items.name: Bent Over Row
items.cues: Maintain 45-degree hip hinge. Row bar to lower chest, elbows close to body. Squeeze shoulder blades at top. Control descent with loaded hold.

items.name: Back Squat
items.cues: Descend with chest upright, knees tracking over toes. Break at hips and knees simultaneously. Drive through midfoot to stand. Full depth with control.

items.name: Assisted Dip
items.cues: Lower body with controlled descent, elbows at 45 degrees from torso. Push through hands to extend arms. Adjust assistance to maintain good form.

items.name: Biceps Curl
items.cues: Keep elbows stationary at sides. Curl dumbbells in controlled arc. Squeeze biceps at the top for 1 second before lowering with control.

items.name: Cable Woodchop
items.cues: Stand perpendicular to cable machine. Rotate through core, extending across body. Maintain neutral spine throughout. Control the eccentric phase.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place forearm on wall at shoulder height. Gently rotate body away. Hold steady stretch, breathe deeply. 30 seconds per side.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Face wall, place hands on wall. Step one leg back, keep heel on ground. Lean forward gently into stretch. 30 seconds per leg.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Perform slow, deliberate repetitions to decompress spine. Focus on breathing and returning to neutral spine position. Finish relaxed.

rationale: Recent training has focused heavily on endurance work (70min sessions) with light strength touches; this 55-minute strength-focused session with RPE 6-7 provides necessary progression while maintaining balance and avoiding overtraining.

User's intermediate fitness level and current 'great' status support moderate-weight, compound movement focus (Bench Press, Rows, Squats) with adequate rest periods (60-90 seconds) appropriate for strength development at RPE 6-7.

Workout includes familiar exercises from recent sessions (Bench Press, 90/90 Hip Switches, Cat-Cow, Bird Dog) ensuring movement pattern continuity while adding complementary lower body and accessory work (Squats, Dips, Curls, Woodchops) for well-rounded strength development.
